messages:
Ada: We're planning a manual rewrap window for envelope KEKs next Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Primary ask: what rollback and audit checks do we need? :lock:
Jordan: Are we doing manual trigger only or allowing auto-rotation fallback? I suggest manual trigger with auto-rotate disabled for that tenant during window.
Liam: From runtime side we need per-KEK feature flag and a canary subset (2 pods) + traffic routing to warm caches.
Sarah: Compliance wants immutable audit events for each object rewrap attempt, plus who triggered it and the KEK ids. retention 7 years.
Ada: Yep. Also need S3 object re-encryption ordering to avoid double-read failures. Plan: rewrap metadata first, then re-encrypt payloads in batches.
Jordan: Re-encrypt will be async. If we fail mid-run, objects with metadata updated but blobs not re-encrypted — need clear detection and retry job.
Nora: Add a `rewrap_status` column in the DB: PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE -> FAILED. Use idempotent resumable workers.
Liam: Observability: emit metrics `rewrap.objects.total`, `rewrap.objects.failed`, `rewrap.objects.latency` and trace spans with `rewrap_id`.
deploy-bot: deploy started: `rewraper:v1.3-canary` to canary group :eyes:
Jordan: Sample dry-run command:
```
rewrap --source-kek aws:kms:alias/redwood-main --target-kek gcp:kms:projects/p/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/k --max-concurrency 20 --dry-run
```
Sarah: Audit hooks must include before/after KEK fingerprint, object id, actor, timestamp, outcome. Store in tamper-evident audit log (append-only).
Ada: Rollback criteria:
- >1% objects FAILED after 1h
- error rate spike in RPCs to KMS
- increased 5xxs in downstream services
If triggered: pause rewrap, mark as FAILED, revert metadata pointers to previous KEK id.
Liam: Reversion plan: metadata has `prior_kek` field so revert is a single update. But payloads may be partially re-encrypted; workers must re-encrypt back or mark for manual ops.
Jordan: RBAC: during window restrict KEK rewrap role to `sec/rewrap-operator` and require MFA. Remove write access to ingest pipelines to avoid new objects landing mid-run.
Sarah: Also ensure audit logs are exported to GCS/Azure blob and checksum verified post-run.
Ada: Timing: 2h window with 30m canary. Start canary on subset 0.5% objects; hold 15m; then ramp. Communication: page owners and ops 24h and 1h before.
Nora: Post-run smoke tests: read+decrypt 100 random objects per shard and run checksum compare.
Ada: OK let's draft runbook and preflight checklist. Assign owners: Jordan (orchestration), Liam (observability), Nora (workers), Sarah (audit & compliance). I'll take lead on coordination.
Jordan: I'll add preflight PR with RBAC terraform changes and a dry-run in staging today. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll open dashboards and alerts for the metrics.
Sarah: Will prepare audit export + retention docs.
Ada: Thanks all. If no objections I'll schedule and send calendar invite.
Jordan: no objections from me.
Nora: LGTM.
